item.title: Gambit 0.1.2
item.description:
# Gambit 0.1.2
Released September 18, 2026.
## Highlights
- Rebuilt Gambit’s native macOS chrome with Liquid Glass navigation surfaces, adaptive transparency, improved toolbar controls, and refined tab focus treatment. - Added persistent, manageable chats with Personal, Agent Research, and AutoPilot modes attached to each chat. - Unified browser tabs, cookies, history, WebKit storage, and Chromium context across chat modes while preserving policy and password safeguards. - Made Chromium the default engine and added an optional Hybrid WebKit setting. - Added safe GitHub-Flavored Markdown rendering for headings, lists, tables, links, blockquotes, and code. - Streamlined agent activity: successful tool calls live under Run details while approvals and failures remain inline. - Added automatic content/domain tab grouping, hover expansion, drag-and-drop grouping, conditional audio controls, and native macOS tab context menus. - Replaced the global Stop All control with a per-chat Stop Session action.
## Reliability and security
- Single-writer ownership now follows the physical shared tab across chat modes. - Chat restoration remains restricted to trusted browser chrome. - Chromium, WebKit, extension popup, and cookie handoff paths use the shared browser identity. - Production Markdown dependencies pass the runtime vulnerability audit.
## Notes
This release is built and published from the local macOS release workflow. Signing and notarization status is determined by the credentials configured on the release machine.
